reading.body:
The operator of this facility is not published and could not be verified through available research tools. The address and facility name appear in public records, but without a website, operator specifications, or power capacity disclosures, nothing about this campus can be read as material to AI scaling decisions.

California has 103 mapped data center facilities of which 11 publish power capacity figures totaling 365 MW. This facility does not appear among those 11 and publishes no specifications for IT load, cooling, electrical supply, or water availability. Its rank by published megawatts is therefore not applicable.

Without disclosed power capacity, electrical interconnection, cooling infrastructure, or grid access details, this site cannot be evaluated for relevance to AI workload hosting or for its position in the state's data center footprint.
